title: License pending invite: detect and guide user to accept
desc: When GitHub collaborator invite is pending (not yet accepted), GET /repos/invitations returns permission=none -- indistinguishable from never-invited. Fix: check invitations endpoint before falling back to Free tier. UX: show Eye callout + numbered console guide so paying users are not silently downgraded.
steps: Eye callout message: activation-pending users must NOT see silent Free tier -- always show numbered guide with github.com/invitations URL
Implementation deferred to license-auth sprint: wire GET /repos/invitations check into LicenseChecker before Free-tier fallback branch
After permission=none: call GET /repos/invitations, match invitee, show numbered guide: 1) check email invite 2) go github.com/invitations 3) accept WKAppBot repo 4) rerun wkappbot

Root cause: spec step 22 assumes permission reflects immediately after invite, but only activates after acceptance. indistinguishable from never-invited until accepted. Better UX than silent Free downgrade.
Business plan draft onboarding document: Customer who paid and gets invite but not yet accepted gets Free tier -- document in onboarding that invite must be accepted before license activates.

requirements.expect: shows activation-pending message when invite not yet accepted
shows Free tier only when no pending invite exists
